plugins.name: blast-guard
plugins.description: Holds risky shell commands for a yes/no with a dry-run report, blocks Python heredocs with backslash escapes, caps concurrent subagents at 4.

plugins.name: cache-meter
plugins.description: Prompt-cache hit rate, context size and TTL in the status line; prices every cache rebuild; /cache-meter summary.

plugins.name: usage-bar
plugins.description: Interactive band above the prompt: context fill, 5-hour and 7-day plan limits with resets, session cost, and a progress row for any subagents.
